## Description
Fe₂O₃ is literally the dominant surface mineral (hematite) — no processing needed beyond crushing.

## Characteristics

| Attribute      | Value |
|--------:|:------|
|Edible:|false|
|Type:|Compound|
|Form:|Solid|
